ModMetaData.name: Wil's Crafting & Workshops
ModMetaData.author: Spaceman_Wil
ModMetaData.description: Woodworker and Stoneworker careers leading to Smith or Tailor, with Weaponsmith, Armorsmith, Mechanist, Couturier and Outfitter specialties. When Wil's Cooking & Hospitality is installed, assigned shop benches become staffed commercial workshops. Early draft: offline builds and tests do not constitute RimWorld gameplay validation.
